{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Black wool blend coat, straight cut, knee length, #000000, fine textured fabric.
Charcoal gray wool trousers, tailored fit, ankle length with slight break, #2F3538, heavy worsted wool.
White poplin shirt, classic collar, long sleeves rolled slightly at cuffs, #FFFFFF, crisp cotton blend.
Silver pearl stud earrings, round shape, medium size, #E0E0E0, sterling silver with pearl accents.
Silver delicate chain necklace, thin link design, short length, #C0C0C0, polished sterling silver.
Black leather ankle boots, pointed toe, low block heel, #1A1A1A, smooth calfskin leather.
This outfit respects the solemnity of a grandfather's funeral while honoring your specific request for silver jewelry. The dark, neutral tones of the charcoal trousers and black coat provide a respectful backdrop for the silvery accents you wish to wear. The tailored wool fabrics offer appropriate warmth and dignity for an early morning autumn service."}
